tshark_cmds:
PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== DHCP hostname and MAC ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "dhcp" -T fields -e dhcp.option.hostname -e dhcp.hw.mac_addr | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== NetBIOS names and sources ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "nbns" -T fields -e nbns.name -e ip.src | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== ARP - IP to MAC mapping ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "arp" -T fields -e arp.src.proto_ipv4 -e arp.src.hw_mac | sort -u

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== Kerberos client names (usernames) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "kerberos.CNameString" -T fields -e kerberos.CNameString | sort -u

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP requests (destination IPs, hosts, methods, URIs) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri | sort -u | head -30

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP POST requests (likely C2 beaconing) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request.method==POST" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.uri | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== DNS queries ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "dns.qry.name" -T fields -e dns.qry.name | sort -u

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== Unique TCP connections from 10.8.15.133 to external IPs (top conversations) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.src==10.8.15.133 && tcp" -T fields -e ip.dst -e tcp.dstport | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== Following TCP stream 0 to see 72.5.43.29:80 communication (verbose, first 50 lines) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -q -z follow,tcp,ascii,0 2>&1 | head -100

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== TCP stream details for 72.5.43.29:80 ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "tcp.dst==72.5.43.29 && tcp.dstport==80" -T fields -e tcp.stream | head -1 | xargs -I {} /opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -q -z follow,tcp,ascii,{} 2>&1 | head -150

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP details from suspicious IPs ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "(ip.dst==72.5.43.29 || ip.dst==104.21.55.70) && http.request" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

# Export HTTP objects
mkdir -p /tmp/pcap_exports
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" --export-objects "http,/tmp/pcap_exports" -q 2>&1

echo "=== Exported files ==="
find /tmp/pcap_exports -type f -exec shasum -a 256 {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -20

echo ""
echo "=== File details ==="
ls -lah /tmp/pcap_exports/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP requests with TeamViewer or DynGate in URL ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri | grep -i "team\|dyngate\|din\.aspx" | head -20

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== All HTTP requests showing URIs and hosts ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.uri | awk '{print $2, $3, $4}' | sort -u | head -30

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP response content type and transfer size from suspicious IPs ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.response && (ip.src==104.21.55.70 || ip.src==72.5.43.29)" -T fields -e ip.src -e http.response.code -e http.content_length | sort -u | head -20

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== Content of first C2 response (159KB payload) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.src==72.5.43.29 && http.response && http.content_length==159232" -T fields -e http.response_body.text | head -c 500

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

# Check for any TLS SNI to see if there are any HTTPS C2 servers
echo "=== TLS SNI (server names) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "tls.handshake.type==1" -T fields -e ip.dst -e tls.handshake.extensions_server_name | sort -u | head -20

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-08-15/2024-08-15-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== Beaconing pattern to 72.5.43.29 - timestamps of HTTP requests ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.src==10.8.15.133 && ip.dst==72.5.43.29 && http.request" -T fields -e frame.time -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri
